% Shared normative core: assumptions and validity
\section{Assumptions and validity domain}
\label{sec:assumptions}

The unbiasedness, response, optimality, and covariance statements are valid
only on the intersection of the following declared predicates. Every product
shall identify which predicates were evaluated, by whose authority, and with
what immutable evidence.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.74\linewidth}}
\toprule
ID & Assumption or predicate \\
\midrule
\endhead
\texttt{ASM-001} & The parent is exactly one immutable normalized ordinary-MAP
observation or coadd bundle with authoritative identity, generation, grouping,
WCS/frame, support, units, calibration provenance, and coadd membership when
applicable. \\
\texttt{ASM-002} & Parent, template, physical amplitude, filtered amplitude,
and coordinate-basis covariance have declared real codomains. The parent and
output anchor lattices have the owner-disposed common WCS/frame/grid/indexing
relation. Coordinate or quadrature changes transform $m,t,C,W$ according to
Section~\ref{sec:measure-convention}; a complex representation preserves
conjugacy and uses the Hermitian adjoint. \\
\texttt{ASM-003} & $t_p$ is the one immutable template-response scientific
object for the application and expresses expected parent response per unit
declared amplitude, with fixed scale, anchor, phase, validity, lineage, and
query vocabulary in an exact representation. \\
\texttt{ASM-004} & Complete $\Supp_{\rm apply}(p)$ is present and valid. No
admitted output depends on fill, extension, imputation, partial support,
edge renormalization, adaptive background, learned taper, or signal-derived
support. Template, state, response, and storage support remain distinct. \\
\texttt{ASM-005} & $W_p$ is the exact frozen, self-adjoint,
positive-semidefinite complete coordinate-basis bilinear weight named by the
selected \AO{001} alternative, including population, units, rank, null,
regularization, window, support, and edge rules. \\
\texttt{ASM-006} & $d_p$ is finite, exactly real, and strictly positive. \\
\texttt{ASM-007} & For amplitude unbiasedness, the admitted noise has zero
conditional mean on the complete support given the frozen state and does not
induce target-dependent changes in the template or operator. \\
\texttt{ASM-008} & For GLS optimality, $C_{\rm parent}$ is the exact authorized
covariance for the population and conditioning; $C_p$ is restricted before
inversion; $C_{p,E}$ is positive definite on the exact estimable subspace; the
projected template is identifiable; and the competitor class is identical. \\
\texttt{ASM-009} & For covariance, the parent law, operator that actually
produced the field, response, support, units, and conditioning state refer to
the same realization and generation; reference quantities remain separate. \\
\texttt{ASM-010} & State follows the declared Learn--Resolve--Apply graph and
is frozen before Apply. It is neither target-updated nor NOI-member relearned. \\
\texttt{ASM-011} & A compatible NOI ensemble member receives the identical
state, operator, support, normalization, numerical profile, and failure policy as
the signal parent. \\
\texttt{ASM-012} & A realized numerical operator is assessed under one
preregistered engineering numerical-conformance profile. An intentional
scientific discrepancy has separate method/realization identity. \\
\texttt{ASM-013} & Covariance scope and representation, response query
vocabulary and representation, and state query vocabulary and representation
satisfy the selected \AO{003}--\AO{005} lifecycle rules. \\
\texttt{ASM-014} & Template and parent calibration lineages are compatible;
any claimed point-source flux meaning or calibration covariance has explicit
CAL/BEAM authority. \\
\texttt{ASM-015} & A method option, named-use policy, and lifecycle route are
explicitly selected; there is no automatic selector, fallback, or silent
substitution. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Validity table}
\label{sec:validity-table}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.16\linewidth}p{0.29\linewidth}p{0.25\linewidth}p{0.20\linewidth}}
\toprule
Dimension & Admission evidence & Invalid or missing case & Required outcome \\
\midrule
\endhead
Parent identity & Exact bundle identity, class, generation, grouping, WCS/frame,
support, unit, quantity, calibration lineage, and coadd membership & Missing,
mutable, derived, or mixed parent & \Unavailable{} before application; no
FLT repair or coaddition. \\
Application class & Observation or coadd declared independently & Assumed
commutation or borrowed state between classes & \Unavailable{}; require a
distinct realization. \\
Output anchors & One anchor at each exact parent pixel center with identical
parent WCS, frame, grid, shape, index, order, and pixel-center convention & Interpolated,
subpixel, oversampled, independently sampled, or ambiguous phase/tie rule &
\Unavailable{} under v0.1; require a separately named successor. \\
Template & Exact response object per unit amplitude with scale, phase, anchor,
sampling, lineage, validity, and query vocabulary & Learned from target/member,
mismatched chart, ambiguous scale, lossy representation, or missing lineage &
\Unavailable{}; no inferred template. \\
Application support & Complete nonzero-coefficient payload closure and erosion
proof, separately typed from state, template, response, and storage support & Missing,
invalid, filled, extended, imputed, or partially supported dependency & Mark
affected anchors \Unavailable{}; no partial estimate. \\
Weighting state & Selected \AO{001}, population, self-adjoint PSD operator,
rank/null, regularization, coefficients, window and edge rules bound at Resolve
& Unknown, unselected, incompatible, or changing $W_p$ & Fail closed; no
fallback. \\
Normalization & Finite, exactly real, strictly positive $d_p$ & NaN,
infinite, complex, zero, negative, or null-confounded &
Location \Unavailable{} or attempted bundle \Failed{}; never write zero. \\
Numerical realization & One preregistered engineering conformance profile with
the exact comparator, projectors, norms, scales, domain, and acceptance rules &
Post-hoc profile, uncovered modes, support/subspace mismatch, or failed rule &
\Failed{} for that profile; a scientific operator change requires distinct
identity. \\
Response & Fixed, full-procedure, realized, and reference types kept distinct,
with selected exact domain/query/representation contract & Undocumented kernel,
assumed invariance, strengthened fixed-state meaning, or unreconstructable
response &
Response-dependent product or handoff \Unavailable{}. \\
Units and calibration & $[\widehat a]=[m]/[t]$ and compatible joint lineage &
Unjustified flux, beam, solid angle, DC, extended-source, or covariance meaning
& Forbid the claim; required named use is \Unavailable{}. \\
Covariance & Matching authorized $C_{\rm parent}$, actual producing operator,
declared scientific scope, and exact selected representation &
Missing population/conditioning, omitted correlations treated as zero, or
$d_p^{-1}$ used without constrained local GLS & Covariance use \Unavailable{} or companion
\Failed{}; signal may remain \Complete{}. \\
NOI parity & Identical frozen transformation for compatible members &
Per-member relearning, different support, or mixed generation & NOI companion
\Unavailable{} or \Failed{}; separate method required. \\
Lifecycle & Atomic membership, named-use policy, and immutable state & Mixed
status, partial signal bundle, silent mutation, or overwritten predecessor &
Bundle \Failed{}; retain predecessor and successor identities. \\
FLT to FRUIT & Selected \AO{005}, documented response/state lineage, and
handoff profile & Requires undocumented implementation state or supplies FRUIT
science & Handoff \Unavailable{}; signal product status is unchanged. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

The valid output domain $\Valid$ is the intersection of all location-level
predicates above. Bundle-level validity additionally requires all atomic
identity and lifecycle members. Consumer-specific validity is never broader
than producer validity and may be narrower under a named-use policy.
